schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan (PM-KUSUM)
schemes.description: Encourages the use of solar energy among farmers by providing financial support for setting up solar pumps and grid-connected solar power plants.
